description: Apple Residents surfaces + AddResidentForm card UX. Restyle ResidentsList and ResidentProfile to the Apple system (badges/tables/tabs), then redesign AddResidentForm into a proper card-based UX: add a TOP-LEVEL Sharing Type selector that filters both the room dropdown and the room-plan cards (UI-only state, NOT submitted, NOT added to the schema), keep Room Plan mandatory + Food Plan optional with nested food plan cards, and replace its three hand-rolled toggles with ToggleSwitch. Depends on FEAT-001. Files: components/residents/ResidentsList.tsx, components/residents/ResidentProfile.tsx, components/residents/AddResidentForm.tsx. IMPORTANT: do NOT change lib/validators/resident.ts, lib/services/checkin.ts, or what is submitted — the food plan must still be appended to `notes` exactly as today. The sharing selector is purely display/filter state.
steps: components/residents/ResidentsList.tsx: h1 -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'; count badge -> 'text-[#007AFF] border-transparent bg-[#007AFF]/10' (remove blue-50/blue-200); Add Resident Button DEFAULT variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green-600). Filter selects: remove className='rounded-lg bg-white' overrides (Select primitive is Apple now; keep w-36/w-44). STATUS_BADGE -> active 'text-[#34C759] border-transparent bg-[#34C759]/10', notice 'text-[#FF9500] border-transparent bg-[#FF9500]/10', left 'text-[#8E8E93] border-transparent bg-[#8E8E93]/10'. Avatar circle -> 'bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF]' (replace bg-green-100 text-green-700). Desktop table container -> 'hidden md:block bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden' + Apple shadow (remove border-gray-100); header TableRow remove 'bg-gray-50'; TableHead -> 'text-xs uppercase tracking-wide font-medium text-[#8E8E93]' (remove font-semibold text-gray-700); rows hover bg-[#F2F2F7]/50. Mobile cards -> 'rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E5EA]' + Apple shadow. Empty-state tile 'bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#8E8E93]'.

components/residents/ResidentProfile.tsx: back link 'text-[#8E8E93] hover:text-[#1C1C1E]'. Header Card: rounded-2xl + Apple shadow (drop border-0 shadow-sm rounded-xl overrides; add border-[#E5E5EA]). Avatar tile -> 'bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF]' (replace bg-green-100 text-green-700). Name -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'. Status badge Apple tints (active #34C759, notice #FF9500, left #8E8E93). Meta icons -> 'text-[#8E8E93]'. Give Notice button -> 'text-[#FF9500] border-[#FF9500]/30 hover:bg-[#FF9500]/10'; Check Out -> 'text-[#FF3B30] border-[#FF3B30]/20 hover:bg-[#FF3B30]/10'. Notice banner -> 'bg-[#FF9500]/10 border border-[#FF9500]/20 text-[#FF9500]' (replace yellow-50/200/800). TabsList -> remove 'bg-white border border-gray-100'; use 'bg-[#F2F2F7] rounded-xl p-1 gap-1 flex-wrap h-auto' (Apple pill tabs); TabsTrigger 'rounded-lg'. Overview cards: rounded-2xl + Apple shadow; section h3 -> 'text-[15px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'; dl labels -> 'text-[#8E8E93]'; values -> 'text-[#1C1C1E]'; notes box -> 'bg-[#F2F2F7]'. Plan history table: Apple header (no bg, uppercase #8E8E93), hover bg-[#F2F2F7]/50; 'Current' badge -> 'text-[#34C759] border-transparent bg-[#34C759]/10'. Placeholder tab icon tiles: rent 'bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500]' (Receipt), payments 'bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF]' (CreditCard), electricity 'bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500]' (Zap), deposit 'bg-[#5856D6]/10 text-[#5856D6]' (Landmark). Dialogs: remove className='rounded-lg' overrides on inputs/selects; Change Plan button DEFAULT variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green-600); Give Notice dialog banner -> 'bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500]'; Record Notice button -> DEFAULT variant but bg-[#FF9500] hover:bg-[#E68B00] text-white rounded-xl (keep semantics). Error boxes -> 'bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30]'.

components/residents/AddResidentForm.tsx — ADD the top-level sharing selector and sharing-based filtering: add state `const [selectedSharing, setSelectedSharing] = useState<'double'|'triple'|''>('')`. In the Step 1 (Stay & Plan) UI, before the Room select, render two Apple selectable cards (Double Sharing / Triple Sharing) bound to selectedSharing; onClick sets selectedSharing AND clears dependent fields: setValue('room',''); setValue('bed',''); setValue('currentPlan',''); setSelectedFoodPlanId(''); setWantsFood(false); setVacantBeds([]). Filter the rooms shown in the Room <SelectContent> to rooms whose sharingType === selectedSharing (when selectedSharing is set). Update the existing roomPlans computation: gate it on selectedSharing so plans match the top selector — `roomPlans = plans.filter((p) => (p.type==='room'||p.type==='room_food') && (!selectedSharing || p.sharingType===selectedSharing))` (this replaces the room-sharing-based filter so the top selector drives both rooms and plans consistently; the existing useEffect still loads vacant beds when a room is chosen). When a room is selected, also setSelectedSharing(room.sharingType) for consistency. Do NOT add selectedSharing to the schema or submission; the submitted room/bed/currentPlan/notes remain identical.

components/residents/AddResidentForm.tsx — TOGGLES: import ToggleSwitch from '@/components/ui/toggle-switch'. Replace the wantsFood toggle (~L495, the w-10 h-5 rounded-full block) with <ToggleSwitch checked={wantsFood} onChange={(v)=>{ setWantsFood(v); if(!v) setSelectedFoodPlanId(''); }} color='orange' size='sm' /> and keep the surrounding card/button layout (make the row a flex justify-between with the label text on the left and the switch on the right). Replace depositReceived toggle (~L642, w-12 h-6 block) with <ToggleSwitch checked={depositReceived} onChange={(v)=>setValue('depositReceived',v)} color='green' />. Replace recordFirstPayment toggle (~L727, w-12 h-6 block) with <ToggleSwitch checked={recordFirstPayment} onChange={(v)=>{ setValue('recordFirstPayment',v); if(v) setValue('firstPaymentAmount', firstMonthRent); }} color='green' />. Keep all conditional reveals (deposit method, first payment fields) unchanged.

components/residents/AddResidentForm.tsx — CARD UX restyle: Room Plan cards selected -> 'border-[#007AFF] bg-[#007AFF]/5' with tile 'bg-[#007AFF] text-white'; inactive -> 'border-[#E5E5EA] bg-white hover:border-[#007AFF]/40 hover:bg-[#007AFF]/5'. Food Plan cards selected -> 'border-[#FF9500] bg-[#FF9500]/10' with tile 'bg-[#FF9500] text-white'; inactive -> 'border-[#E5E5EA] bg-white hover:border-[#FF9500]/40'. Keep the 'Mandatory'/'Optional' badges and meal-icon logic (getMealIcon/getMealLabel). Stepper circles: active/complete -> 'bg-[#007AFF] text-white' + 'ring-[#007AFF]/20' (replace green-600/green-100); step header icon -> 'text-[#007AFF]'. Main Card uses new Apple defaults; section inner boxes -> 'rounded-xl border border-[#E5E5EA]'; nested deposit/first-rent panels keep 'border-l-2 border-[#34C759]/30'. Price summary -> 'bg-[#F2F2F7] rounded-xl border border-[#E5E5EA]', total -> 'text-[#1C1C1E]'. Error banner -> 'bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30]'; ID info banner -> 'bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF] border-[#007AFF]/20' (replace blue-50/blue-200). Nav buttons: Back/Cancel = outline variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green overrides); Next/Submit = DEFAULT variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green-600). All inputs/selects: remove per-field 'rounded-xl h-10' overrides (primitives are Apple); keep type='date'/'number' inputs. The 'No vacant beds' empty SelectItem stays. Do not change the onSubmit notes-appending logic.
acceptance_criteria: ResidentsList header is 22px semibold #1C1C1E; status badges use the Apple tint system; avatar circles are blue; table has no outer border, uppercase #8E8E93 header, #F2F2F7/50 row hover.
ResidentProfile tabs are Apple pill tabs; header avatar is blue tint; status/notice banners use Apple tints; placeholder tab icon tiles use Apple tints; Record Notice button is orange Apple style.
AddResidentForm has a top-level Double/Triple sharing selector; selecting one filters BOTH the room dropdown and the room-plan cards; selectedSharing is not submitted and not added to the schema.
Selecting Double hides Triple plans/rooms and vice-versa; Room Plan stays Mandatory and Food Plan stays Optional with nested food plan cards revealed by the orange ToggleSwitch.
All three AddResidentForm toggles (wantsFood orange, depositReceived green, recordFirstPayment green) render as iOS ToggleSwitches; no hand-rolled knob spans remain.
Room/Food plan selected states use blue/orange Apple colors (not green/orange-400); stepper uses #007AFF; no green button overrides remain.
lib/validators/resident.ts and lib/services/checkin.ts are unchanged; the food plan is still appended to notes on submit.
Running `npm run build` passes with 0 TypeScript errors.
verification: Optionally npm run dev, go to /residents/new, pick Triple sharing -> confirm only triple rooms and triple plans appear; toggle food on -> confirm food plan cards appear; confirm toggles animate like iOS switches.
Grep components/residents/AddResidentForm.tsx for 'rounded-full transition' / 'translate-x-' to confirm no hand-rolled toggle spans remain.
